title: Frontend Jest test environment boot and setup execution order
answers: What order do Jest setup files run in frontend/?
How is the Jest test environment initialized for PostHog frontend tests?
Where are global mocks and polyfills registered in frontend Jest tests?
body:
When Jest executes frontend tests, environment initialization flows through distinct phases configured in `frontend/jest.config.ts`:
1. Module resolution: `frontend/jest.resolver.js` routes MSW v2 packages through Node export conditions instead of JSDOM browser conditions.
2. Polyfill setup (`setupFiles[0]`): `frontend/jest.polyfills.js` injects Undici fetch and Web Streams globals onto `globalThis` before JSDOM clobbers Node primitives.
3. Mock & quarantine setup (`setupFiles[1..2]`): `frontend/jest.setup.ts` configures browser mocks (`matchMedia`, canvas, observers), followed by `frontend/jest.quarantine.ts` patching test globals (`it`, `test`, `describe`).
4. Post-environment setup (`setupFilesAfterEnv`): `frontend/jest.setupAfterEnv.ts` sets `global.React = React` once the React testing environment is active.
